resources.string: A black screen, broken pictures, no sound: say it in one line. It goes to the XRecomp developers with the last game\'s log and its last events, once you have seen what is sent and chosen Send.

Sent only if you choose Send: your line, the game\'s log and its last events (no names, only what was done), without folders, addresses or links. No game data, no account, no e-mail.
